# Vendored from trutohq/elaichi-skills — do not edit here

`elaichi.mdc` in this directory is **generated** by `scripts/generate-rule.mjs`
from the vendored `skills/elaichi-conventions/SKILL.md`, whose source is
[trutohq/elaichi-skills](https://github.com/trutohq/elaichi-skills). Do not
hand-edit it here. Edit that skill there, then run
`node scripts/sync-skills.mjs` in this repo, which re-vendors the skills and
regenerates the rule.

Direction of copy: `elaichi-skills` → `elaichi-cursor-plugin`, always.
